newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain doing homework, no comment on Buba - Montoro.
newsitem.headline: Spain doing homework, no comment on Buba - Montoro.

text.p: Spanish Economy Secretary Cristobal Montoro declined on Thursday to comment on the faceoff between the German government and the Bundesbank, but said the euro would be launched on time and Spain would be part of it.

"No member of the government's team has evaluated what other countries are doing. Simply, we are working on our homework and making sure our country is more credible all the time," Montoro told journalists on the fringes of a euro seminar.
Montoro said he considered the planned euro timetable irreversible.
"It's too late for new doubts about the process. It isn't the time for doubts," Montoro told the seminar.
